sentences.text:
Heard Shri S.K. Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner, Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents and Shri S.C. Dwivedi, learned counsel for respondent No.4.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to declare rehabilitation and resettlement award under Section 31 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter Balchand Ram vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148637311/
1 referred to as 'the Act') within a specified time frame and also to pay interest to the petitioner from December 2016 upto 04.11.2022, when the compensation amount was paid to him.

sentences.text: 3. The case of the petitioner is that although the award for the acquired land was made on 14.03.2020 but rehabilitation award in terms of Section 31 has not been made so far.
Moreover, the petitioner has also not been been paid interest in terms of Section 80 of the Act.
He points out that his application for payment of interest filed on 31.07.2023 is still pending.
4. The respondents are in receipt of instructions.
According to which, it is not in dispute that the land of the petitioner was acquired and compensation was also paid to him.
However, rehabilitation award, admittedly, has not been made so far nor the respondents have decided application of the petitioner for payment of interest.
5. In the instructions furnished, it is stated that the petitioner is not entitled to any interest but without disclosing any reason therefor.

6. In the circumstances aforesaid, we dispose of the instant petition, as agreed to by the counsel for the parties, by providing that respondents will hold inquiry and declare rehabilitation and resettlement award under Section 31 of the Act within a period of twelve weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.

We further provide that the application of the petitioner dated 31.07.2023 for payment of interest shall be decided by the Competent Authority i.e. respondent No.3 by passing a speaking order within eight weeks from the date of communication of the instant order.

Order Date :- 12.1.2024 Jyotsana (Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, A.C.J.)
